Hi all - checking in on this. We have fixed a majority of invite lost issues but there seem to be a few more issues remaining. Please let us know if you are still experiencing this!

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: I still get weird lost friend requests, and invite bugs. I invited someone to a world once, and someone completely different joined. Friend requests are sometimes accepted but they still appear un-friended on my end. Amongst other oddities

The vast majority of these issues should no longer occur. Marking this as complete.

The only time this may still occur is if the user having the problem is experiencing pretty major network issues.

If you're still experiencing issues with not receiving Invites that you *know for a fact that were sent* (as in, verified via speaking to the sender), please let us know by sending us a support ticket at http://help.vrchat.com/new. Ensure that you include your output log, as well as the method you used to verify that the original invite was sent.

details:
I have noticed a very irritating bug/glitch, that i don't know how to fix.
when i request an invite to a private world to a friend, it comes in on their side, but their accepting invite doesn't appear at all on my side. this happens every single time for about a week now. (it started happening for me after the Cloudflare issue)

and i know my friend accepted my request, cause he joined on me later, thinking i was afk, and told me that he accepted it about 3 times already, but i didn't come (confirming my invite requests do seem to go through) and i told him that none of his invites came up for me on my side, which is why i didn't (wasn't able to) join.

This is really annoying the sh*t out of me, i'm hoping this will get fixed soon.

I have tried completely reinstalling VRChat and deletingthe cache with no luck and tried reseting the router too, also no luck.
title: Request Invite sending correctly to friend, but when accepted doesn't appear on my end.
